help.title: Help & FAQ
help.q1: How does the virtual queue work?
help.a1: Join from anywhere — you get a token number. Watch your live position and ETA. Walk in only when you're called. Your place is safe even if you Step Away for up to 5 minutes.
help.q2: What if I'm called and I'm not there?
help.a2: You get a 90-second grace timer with sound, vibration and notification. Scan your QR at the counter or tap “I'm at the counter” to stop it. Miss it and you're auto-skipped (marked no-show).
help.a3: Yes — Q-Mate is offline-first. Tokens and queues live on your device (IndexedDB) and sync across tabs instantly. AI extras degrade gracefully to local engines.
help.q4: How are priority tokens kept fair?
help.a4: Differently-abled, emergency and faculty tokens skip ahead, but staff verify them and a fair-play cap allows at most one priority per 4 standard tokens.
help.q5: Where do the green numbers come from?
help.a5: Every completed token avoids a paper ticket, HVAC load while standing in line, and (when you join remotely) a commute. Factors are configurable and shown on the Sustainability report.
help.contact: Still stuck? Ask Q-Buddy (bottom-right) or visit the counter block with your token.
